caseName: West Virginia ex rel. Sublett v. Adams
caseNameFull: West Virginia ex rel. Sublett v. Adams, Warden

opinions.text:
Motion to substitute Otto C. Boles in the place of D. E. Adams as the party respondent granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia denied.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and application.
